# Phase 1 vintage analysis (generated by src/phase1/vintage.py)

Cumulative default rate (% of loans originated) by months on book. Default month ≈ last_pymnt_d + 1. Risk bands = M1-score quintiles fixed on train (B1 riskiest): B1 ≤532, B2 532–542, B3 542–551, B4 551–563, B5 >563. 2012Q3 = September 2012 only. Empty = not yet observable (needs issue + MOB ≤ 2018-09).
